summary: Satellos Bioscience Inc. (Z4) filed a Form 6-K on June 17, 2026 furnishing a report of voting results from its annual meeting held virtually the same day. The filing covers election of nine director nominees, with votes ranging from 83.76% to 99.99% in favor, and appointment of PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP as auditor (98.69% in favor). Approximately 55.33% of outstanding shares were represented. No price, premium, deal terms, advisor, or special-situation mechanics are present. This is a routine foreign private issuer report of shareholder meeting results with no corporate transaction or special situation.
